title: TUFS Basic Vocabulary
name: TUFS
tagline: Basic vocabulary for language learning — Tokyo University of Foreign Studies

main.description: Main lexical database — 23 languages linked to Open English WordNet.

provenance.description: Provenance records tracing every data point back to its source.

about.intro:
The TUFS Basic Vocabulary links the core vocabulary used for language teaching at Tokyo University of Foreign Studies (TUFS) with the Open Multilingual Wordnet.

Source code and data are at GitHub. The interface uses Cygnet (Maudslay & Bond, 2026)
about.citation: If you use this resource, please cite Bond et al (2020).
about.languageData: The TUFS Basic Vocabulary covers 23 languages: Arabic, Assamese, German, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Japanese, Khmer, Korean, Lao, Mongolian, Malay, Burmese, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese, Russian, Thai, Filipino, Turkish, Urdu, Vietnamese, and Chinese. All data is released under CC BY 4.0.

publications: Francis Bond, Hiroki Nomoto, Luis Morgado da Costa and Arthur Bond (2020). Linking the TUFS Basic Vocabulary to the Open Multilingual Wordnet. In Proceedings of the 12th Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2020), pp. 3171–3177.

Rowan Hall Maudslay & Francis Bond (2026). Cygnet: Refactoring the Open Multilingual Wordnet. In Proceedings of the 15th International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC 2026). (to appear)

Kawaguchi, Yuji. 2007. Foundations of Center of Usage-Based Linguistic Informatics (UBLI). In Yuji Kawaguchi, Toshihiro Takagaki, Nobuo Tomimori and Yoichiro Tsuruga (eds.) Corpus-Based Perspectives in Linguistics, pp 3-28. Amsterdam: John Benjamins. DOI: 10.1075/ubli.6.02kaw
